Wiz:
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
If you are interested at all in conversation with Wiz, or if you have questions about her or want more information about something related to her (such as her history), I encourage you to ask me in her channel or DM me about it. I’m very open to questions or working on new banter with her and would much prefer to do so in a structured and organized fashion.
- Pandora Rahl
* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *
About Wiz:

Wiz is a lich who, before becoming undead, was a powerful adventurer known by the moniker “Ice Witch”. She runs a magic item shop in the beginner town of Axel. Her store is mostly filled with magic items of very specific uses or with significant drawbacks. Her potions and wares are mostly geared toward adventurers but she also stocks simpler items for the townsfolk, as well as incredibly niche items that never seem to sell.

Personality:

- Wiz is very meek and clumsy, and is always the first to apologize when something goes wrong, even if it’s not her fault. A stark contrast to how she was before becoming a lich, where she was headstrong and competitive. She is kind and well respected in Axel, and is taking her “life”… slower, and experiencing more since never taking the time to do so as a prominent adventurer. She gives off a gentle, older sister vibe.
- Wiz can be a little dense at times and sometimes misses social cues if they aren't overt. She doesn't always notice if someone is flirting with her and may interpret it as them being nice, or she may miss that someone is done with a conversation topic and just keep trying to continue it. This often leads to her panicking and apologizing when she does eventually catch on.
- Despite having turned undead, Wiz possesses even more power than she did when she was alive, as she no longer has a limit to the amount of magical energy that her body can contain, unlike when she was human. She, however, hesitates to use such power because she knows how devastating it is, and will only use it under extreme conditions, or when innocent people are in danger. (To give you an idea of how much power she has, she too, can cast Explosion like Megumin, with over 3x the power, and can still move around with plenty of mana to spare.)
- Being a lich, the highest rank of undead, Wiz can’t die or age, per se, but she can be exorcised or destroyed. She fears moving on above all else, and will desperately plead if she is in danger of it, usually at the hands of Aqua. If she is near any kind of holy/sacred item, is hit by holy magic, or is hit by an extremely powerful spell/attack, she will start fading rapidly, and have almost no energy to move. She can only be restored with another’s vitality, or by a long period of rest away from holy power.
- Wiz has absolutely no business sense whatsoever. She often stocks items that are useful, but tend to have specific terrible drawbacks. She has yet to turn in a profit, leaving Vanir, also a fellow former Devil King general, to make all the money… which she ends up spending on more useless items to sell anyway. Vanir typically punishes her for this by forcing her to eat nothing but scraps, or zapping her to near oblivion.
- She has come to the Inventory for a myriad of reasons, all of which Vanir told her to take advantage of so that she’d get out of the shop and fix her latest inventory blunder. These included meeting a great variety of new people, a chance at acquiring new business, and discovering an unexplored side of herself. Wiz, for her part, is also interested in exploring her sexuality a bit more as she is totally inexperienced with dating otherwise. So she's trying to put herself out there a bit more than she normally would even if it makes her nervous or embarrassed.
- Wiz was 20 when she became a lich and stopped aging, and that is more or less the age she should appear to other characters now. It is unclear in source just how long it has been since then, however. There is no definitive frame of reference for it. In SPNatI, she is around 40, so she has a lot of life experience to fall back on.

Targetable traits:

- Wiz is a powerful sorceress, specifically an arch wizard. She isn’t one to brag about her power, but doesn’t mind talking about it, while unintentionally telling how powerful she is. Contrary to being able to use the power to get whatever she wanted, she’ll usually submit and apologize rapidly.
- Wiz is an ex-adventurer and was quite infamous in her time, feared by both enemies and other adventurers. However, little is known about her old party except the names of its members, so conversation about specific events from her past would be difficult. But general conversation about adventuring or fighting monsters, or questions about specific monsters if that’s of interest to your character, is totally fine. There’s a lot to draw on there from the Konosuba universe and Wiz can speak on behalf of adventurers in general.
- While she hides being undead from most people in her hometown, she's attempting to be more open about it here at the Inventory and will answer questions about it. She's still self-conscious, though, as she's used to people treating undead like they do monsters. Don’t let that stop you from engaging with her that way if that’s what your character would do. If it means maintaining genial conversation becomes difficult, that is fine. But it may be hard to maintain that type of conversation into her later stages.
- Wiz won’t mind trying to talk business and other strategies, and she’ll need plenty of advice, considering she has none. She’ll also try selling her wares at times if one of her items matches the need of another at the table, or if asked for recommendations. I will always try to pull from canon when recommending items, but there are a very limited number of such items that can really help outside of adventuring. Her wares tend to be highly specific, not multi-purpose.
- Being a shopkeeper, Wiz is good at talking to her customers and other people about their problems and experiences, but she is somewhat shy about talking about herself. She's an empathetic person, and she'll be happy to listen to anyone's problems or concerns, and either offer her own advice or perspective, or just talk through it with them.
- Wiz is easily intimidated and tricked, if that's an angle you want to take. Wiz will usually catch on eventually though, and will probably be pretty upset following that. Nevertheless, it may prove to bring out interesting responses.
- Similarly, she's submissive and not very confident in her body or looks (partly stemming from Axel's citizens treating her as an "off limits" beauty, something she’s not aware of happening), so she'll definitely freak out at first at genuine compliments or teasing. But she'll very much appreciate them and return such niceties in kind.
- Wiz is a virgin and has not dated, but sexual talk is, of course, welcome. She’s very much trying to learn more about her own sexuality at The Inventory. So she’ll approach such conversation from that perspective, with her own interests, her own fantasies, etc.
- Wiz’s history and events that led to her becoming a lich are not the happiest. She’ll answer simple questions about what happened, and defend her actions if accused of having made poor decisions, but if you would want to delve deeper into those events it would be best to plan that out ahead of time. Unfortunately, besides the very specific events surrounding this change, little is known about her or her party prior to the events of Konosuba. It just hasn’t been addressed in any form. So conversations about specific events from her adventuring days or about her relationships with her old party may prove difficulty.

case.description: Wiz is apprehensive about being the only (revealed) undead at the table. She's used to people fearing and hunting undead.

case.name: Another Undead!!
case.description: Wiz is excited to meet another undead (that isn't a vampire)! She has a variety of questions for her compatriot. (Check for more questions in the same folder.)

case.name: Oh… a Vampire…
case.description: Wiz hasn't had great experiences with vampires and has less to say to them, even showing a bit of hostility. But that could change in the future. (I'd rather explore that in banter, though.)

case.name: Should I Really…?

case.name: Items for Sale!
case.description: Wiz offers all sorts of items to players based on their tags. Check the Sales Offers folder for ones that may apply to your character, and the notes tab for a bit more information. And if you want some sort of follow-up to your response, leave a note or let me know!

case.name: Check Wiz's Markers!

Try looking through them if you're looking for more to respond to, and check the "z Filters" folder or the relevant case to find them. They won't all be appropriate for that, but there are some that may be interesting to some characters.
